ops.oldText: Customer shall not solicit, hire, or employ any Vendor employee during the term or for twenty-four months afterward, regardless of how the employee applies.
ops.newText: Customer shall not solicit any Vendor personnel during the term or for 12 months after the end of their involvement in the Services.

ops.text: Vendor shall not solicit any Customer personnel during the term or for 12 months after the end of their involvement in the Services, so that the restriction is mutual; this sentence and the preceding sentence apply only to personnel directly involved in the Services and do not restrict either Party from placing general advertisements or from hiring any person who makes an unsolicited approach.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have narrowed 12.4 to solicitation only of personnel directly involved in the Services for 12 months after their involvement ends, removing the no-hire and the 24-month all-employee sweep, and added an express reciprocal Vendor covenant with carve-outs for general advertisements and unsolicited approaches. This is our fallback position and it also aligns the text with Section 12.3.
proposal.summary: Narrow Section 12.4 to the express mutual 12-month, Services-personnel non-solicit and delete the no-hire

mappings.element: Non-solicit limited to personnel directly involved in the Services.
Non-solicit limited to 12 months from the end of their involvement.
